opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted under Charity Commission guidance; must have at least one year’s worth of annual accounts and meet the eligibility quiz.
opportunities.summary: Open to eligible UK charities for operating/core costs, capital projects or specific activity grants. Regular grants are under £100,000, with no submission deadline; applications are accepted all year round and decisions are communicated within 4–6 months.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted under Charity Commission guidance; must have annual income over £1 million or total project/capital costs over £1 million, and at least one year’s worth of annual accounts.
opportunities.summary: Major grants of £100,000 and above are considered by the Trustees at eight board meetings per year. Applications (expressions of interest) are accepted all year round with no deadline; decisions are made on a rolling basis.
